title: Reading: The General Prologue, Lines 1–18
subtitle: Whan that Aprill... to pilgrimages.
objectives: Master Reading: The General Prologue, Lines 1–18.
Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body:
Whan that Aprill with his shoures soote
The droghte of March hath perced to the roote...
Thanne longen folk to goon on pilgrimages.

'When April with his sweet showers has pierced the drought of March to the root... Then people long to go on pilgrimages.'

The opening verse paragraph. Full grammatical commentary on every line.
